intro: These are the rates we discussed, laid out so you can pick what you actually want and see the number move. Nothing here is a commitment. Choose your options, add any questions for our follow-up meeting, and send it back to us.

support.title: Unlimited IT support
support.blurb: Flat monthly number. Call as often as you need, no clock running, no per-ticket charges. Put each person on the tier that matches how much they actually use IT. Every tier carries the same security stack, so the only thing that changes between them is how much support is included. A one-time $200 onboarding fee applies, and it is credited off in full if we are also doing your email migration.

tiers.label: Full-time users
tiers.hint: The people who actually lean on IT and call us.

tiers.label: Part-time users
tiers.hint: Full security, and support there if they ever need it.

tiers.label: Security only, no support
tiers.hint: The full security stack, no support included.
tiers.note: If one of these people does need support, it is pay as you go at our hourly rates for that visit, unless you upgrade them to part-time or full-time. An upgrade starts on the first of the following month.

support.note: Support is the part that scales down, which is what the $50 and $25 tiers do. Security does not scale down. Anyone who can reach your Google Workspace can reach company mail and company data, so every one of those machines carries the same protection either way. $25 is the floor for anyone with an account.
support.escalation: Move people between the three bars whenever you like. Changes take effect on the first of the following month, and that works in both directions — people come down a tier, or off entirely, as freely as they go up, and you are never locked into a headcount. The one thing that does not work is moving someone up for a fix and straight back down the week after; a tier has to hold for the month it covers.

projects.label: Migrate Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace
projects.blurb: Mail, contacts and calendars moved across, every mailbox rebuilt on the Google side, each user set up on their devices. Nothing cuts over until it has been tested. Past 10 mailboxes we requote with you before any work starts.

onboarding.creditNote: Standing your environment up and moving your mail are largely the same work, so we are not charging you for both.

licensing.title: Google Workspace licensing
licensing.payee: paid to Google, not to us
licensing.blurb: Moving to Google means Google seats. These are Google's own published rates, billed by them and not by us, shown so you can see the whole monthly picture.
licensing.hint: Annual-commitment rate. Month to month costs more per user, and we can set it up either way.

plans.name: Business Starter
plans.note: 30 GB pooled per user. $8.40 month to month.

plans.name: Business Standard
plans.note: 2 TB per user, recording, larger meetings.

plans.name: Business Plus
plans.note: 5 TB per user, Vault, advanced controls.
